title: Half-plane convergence
statement:
Let $(D,E_2,\alpha,f,g)$ be the exact couple of
[def-sp-exact-couple]. Assume $D^{p,q}=0$ for $q<a$, and $E_2^{p,q}=0$ unless
$p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$. Put $A^n=D^{0,n}$. Then total degree $n$ contains
only $a\leq q\leq n$, and each entry $E_r^{p,q}$ has stabilized when

$$
 r>\max(q-a+1,\,p),
$$

with the canonical identification $E_r^{p,q}=E_{r+1}^{p,q}$ supplied by page
cohomology. For $q\leq n$, set
$G_qA^n=\operatorname{im}(D^{n-q,q}\xrightarrow{\alpha^{n-q}}A^n)$, and set
$G_qA^n=A^n$ for $q\geq n$. The decreasing filtration
[def-sp-filtration] $F^pA^n=G_{n-p}A^n$ is finite, exhaustive and separated,
and $E_\infty^{p,q}\cong F^pA^{p+q}/F^{p+1}A^{p+q}$. The couple is regular
and complete in the sense of [def-sp-convergence].

proof.text:
The page region gives $p\geq0$ and $q\geq a$; on $p+q=n$ these inequalities
give the finite interval $a\leq q\leq n$, so each total degree contains
finitely many entries. For an entry $(p,q)$, the incoming differentials at
page $r$ are

$$
  d_r:E_r^{p-r,q+r-1}\longrightarrow E_r^{p,q},
$$

whose source has first index $p-r<0$, hence vanishes when $r>p$; the outgoing
differentials are

$$
  d_r:E_r^{p,q}\longrightarrow E_r^{p+r,q-r+1},
$$

whose target has second index $q-r+1<a$, hence vanishes when $r>q-a+1$. The
degrees are those of [def-sp-exact-couple]. For $r>\max(q-a+1,p)$, taking
page cohomology identifies the two successive entries. The recursive
subobjects of [def-sp-convergence] therefore stabilize, giving regularity.
For completeness,

$$
 \operatorname{im}(\alpha^r)^{p,q}
 =\operatorname{im}\bigl(\alpha^r:D^{p+r,q-r}\to D^{p,q}\bigr)=0
$$

for $r>q-a$, by the stated hypothesis on $D$. Exactness of the original
couple shows that $\alpha:D^{n-q+1,q-1}\to D^{n-q,q}$ is an isomorphism for
$q>n$: both adjacent $E_2$-terms have negative first index. Thus $A^n$ is the
stable value of this system. Its image filtration has $G_q=0$ for $q<a$ and
$G_q=A^n$ for $q\geq n$.

For the associated graded, fix $(p,q)$ with $p\geq0$ and choose $r$ so large that
$r>\max(q-a+1,p)$ and $u:=p-r+2\leq0$. Put $v:=q+r-2$, so $u+v=p+q$. By
[lem-sp-derived-couple-exact], $D_r^{u,v}=\operatorname{im}(D^{p,q}\xrightarrow{\alpha^{r-2}}D^{u,v})$.
Exactness of the iterated couple identifies this image, via the isomorphism
$\alpha^{-u}:D^{0,p+q}=A^{p+q}\xrightarrow{\sim}D^{u,v}$ from Step 1, with
$G_qA^{p+q}=\operatorname{im}(D^{p,q}\to A^{p+q})$. Likewise the image of
$\alpha_r:D_r^{u+1,v-1}\to D_r^{u,v}$ corresponds to
$G_{q-1}A^{p+q}$. The next term in the exact sequence is
$D_r^{p+2,q-1}=\operatorname{im}(D^{p+r,q-r+1}\to D^{p+2,q-1})$, which is zero
because $q-r+1<a$. Hence exactness gives a short exact sequence
$D_r^{u+1,v-1}\xrightarrow{\alpha_r}D_r^{u,v}\xrightarrow{g_r}E_r^{p,q}\to0$,
so $E_r^{p,q}\cong G_qA^{p+q}/G_{q-1}A^{p+q}$. This isomorphism is the canonical one: iterating the defining property $g'\circ\bar\alpha=\pi\circ\hat g$ of [lem-sp-derived-couple-exact] gives $g_r(\alpha^{r-2}y)=\overline{g(y)}$ for $y\in D^{p,q}$, so the maps $D^{p,q}\to E_\infty^{p,q}=E_r^{p,q}$ (Step 1: $Z$ and $B$ are constant from page $r$ on) and $D^{p,q}\to\operatorname{gr}^pA^{p+q}$ of [def-sp-convergence] are both onto with the same kernel. The filtration is finite ($F^pA^n=A^n$ for $p\leq0$, $F^pA^n=0$ for $p>n-a$), hence exhaustive, separated and complete. For $p<0$, both sides are
zero by the half-plane hypothesis. This is the asserted associated graded of
[def-sp-filtration], and proves convergence in the sense of
[def-sp-convergence].

(Stacks Project: Tag
[011T](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/011T) ($Z_r$, $B_r$ and the rule
for $d_{r+1}$ of an exact couple); compare Tag
[012F](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/012F) ($E_\infty$ and the
associated graded of the cohomology).)

lean.statement: theorem halfPlaneConvergence (X : BigradedExactCouple C 0) (a : ℤ) (hD : ∀ (p q : ℤ), q < a → IsZero (X.D p q)) (hE : ∀ (p q : ℤ), (p < 0 ∨ q < a) → IsZero (X.E p q)) : ∃ L : LimitSubobjects X, ∃ A : ∀ n : ℤ, AlphaColimit X n, ∃ hA : ∀ n : ℤ, (A n).obj = X.D 0 n, (∀ n : ℤ, (A n).ι 0 ≫ eqToHom (hA n) = eqToHom (by congr 1; omega)) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (n p q : ℤ), p + q = n → ¬ IsZero ((X.pageCouple r).E p q) → a ≤ q ∧ q ≤ n) ∧ (∀ (r : ℕ) (p q : ℤ), (r : ℤ) + 2 > max (q - a + 1) p → ∃ e : (X.pageCouple r).E p q ≅ (X.pageCouple (r + 1)).E p q, kernel.ι ((X.pageCouple r).d p q) ≫ e.hom = (X.pageCouple r).derivedEProjection p q) ∧ (∀ (n p : ℤ), p ≤ 0 → (X.imageFiltration n (A n)).step p = ⊤) ∧ (∀ n : ℤ, (X.imageFiltration n (A n)).IsFinite ∧ (X.imageFiltration n (A n)).IsExhaustive ∧ (X.imageFiltration n (A n)).IsSeparated) ∧ (∀ (p q : ℤ), ∃ e : X.pageInfinity L p q ≅ (X.imageFiltration (p + q) (A (p + q))).gradedPiece p, X.toPageInfinity L p q ≫ e.hom = X.toGradedPiece A p q) ∧ X.IsComplete ∧ X.ConvergesTo L A
